_comment: Final-approach constraint campaign (docs/2026-09-04_constraint_methods_survey.zh.md, P0-P1). Same recipe as the airport-frame campaign's arm A (state-v1 defaults, iTransformer, full horizon, all aircraft, threshold ENU), same manifest / roster / split seed, so every arm is paired flight-by-flight with A on the validation split. P0: the inference-time projection of arm A's own forecasts onto the corridor (no training; the ceiling of what the final-segment constraint recovers after the fact) under the deployable on-final gate, plus the FAF-gated ablation on one seed. P1: the bounded output (state_position_reference=corridor-bounded, on-final gate: the constraint holds by construction, no weight) and, as its paired control, the runway-scale hinge penalty with primal-dual weights (procedure_loss_*; epsilon = the tolerated violation RATE on truth-gated rows). Pre-registered reading: the bounded arm should remove the KRDU straight-in lateral miss (~+200 m) and leave the vectored stratum unchanged (its rows are off the final by the gate's own account); a vectored-stratum regression on both seeds vetoes it, as it did state-v2. The penalty arm should reach a violation rate near epsilon with lambda finding its own level; if it needs a lambda that costs ADE the reading is 'the constraint conflicts with the objective at this scale', not 'try a bigger weight'. Read every margin against the seed floor (A: 5-22 m pooled ADE). CALIBRATION (compare_constraint_arms.py on arm A, KRDU val, truth-gated rows): unweighted lateral hinge (metres outside the k-cone / 100 m, squared, per-flight mean) = 6.0 straight-in, 90.6 vectored, 38.8 pooled; vertical = 10.8 / 67.9 / 32.9; the position term at convergence is ~0.04-0.08, so lambda = 1e-3 puts the pooled penalty at about the position term and 1e-2 at ~10x. Arm A's violation rates on those rows: lateral 77 % (KRDU) / 34 % (KSJC), vertical 62 % / 38 %, against observed floors of 0 % (by construction of the gate) and 6 % / 1.6 %. Hence C starts both lambdas at 1e-3 and raises them by 1e-3 x (rate - 0.05) per epoch: ~7e-4 per epoch at the start, zero at the target rate, at most ~0.1 over the run.
